text_en: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to lead a life worthy of the calling to which you have been called,
text_cn: 所以我这在主内为囚犯的恳求你们，行动务要与你们所受的宠召相称，

text_en: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
text_cn: 凡事要谦逊、温和、忍耐，在爱德中彼此担待，

text_en: making every effort to maintain the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
text_cn: 尽力以和平的联系，保持心神的合一，

text_en: There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to the one hope of your calling,
text_cn: 因为只有一个身体和一个圣神，正如你们蒙召，同有一个希望一样。

text_en: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
text_cn: 只有一个主，一个信德，一个洗礼；

text_en: one God and Father of all, who is above all and through all and in all.
text_cn: 只有一个天主和众人之父，他超越众人，贯通众人，且在众人之内。

text_en: But each of us was given grace according to the measure of Christ’s gift.
text_cn: 但我们各人所领受的恩宠，却是按照基督赐恩的尺度。

text_en: Therefore it is said, “When he ascended on high he made captivity itself a captive; he gave gifts to his people. ”
text_cn: 为此经上说：“他带领俘虏，升上高天，且把恩惠赐与人。”

text_en: (When it says, “He ascended, ” what does it mean but that he had also descended into the lower parts of the earth?
text_cn: 说他上升了，岂不是说他曾下降到地下吗？

text_en: He who descended is the same one who ascended far above all the heavens, so that he might fill all things. )
text_cn: 那下降的，正是上升超乎诸天之上，以充满万有的那一位，

text_en: The gifts he gave were that some would be apostles, some prophets, some evangelists, some pastors and teachers,
text_cn: 就是他赐与这些人作宗徒，那些人作先知，有的作传福音者，有的作司牧和教师，

text_en: to equip the saints for the work of ministry, for building up the body of Christ,
text_cn: 为成全圣徒，使之各尽其职；为建树基督的身体，

text_en: until all of us come to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to maturity, to the measure of the full stature of Christ.
text_cn: 直到我们众人都达到对于天主子，有一致的信仰和认识，成为成年人，达到基督圆满年龄的程度；

text_en: We must no longer be children, tossed to and fro and blown about by every wind of doctrine, by people’s trickery, by their craftiness in deceitful scheming.
text_cn: 使我们不再做小孩子，为各种教义之风所飘荡，所卷去，而中了人的阴谋，陷于引入荒谬的诡计；

text_en: But speaking the truth in love, we must grow up in every way into him who is the head, into Christ,
text_cn: 反而在爱德中持守真理，在各方面长进，而归于那为元首的基督，

text_en: from whom the whole body, joined and knit together by every ligament with which it is equipped, as each part is working properly, promotes the body’s growth in building itself up in love.
text_cn: 本着他，全身都结构紧凑，藉着各关节的互相补助，按照各肢体的功用，各尽其职，使身体不断增长，在爱德中将它建立起来。

text_en: Now this I affirm and insist on in the Lord: you must no longer live as the Gentiles live, in the futility of their minds.
text_cn: 为此我说，且在主内苦劝你们，生活不要像外邦人，顺随自己的虚妄思念而生活；

text_en: They are darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of their ignorance and hardness of heart.
text_cn: 他们的理智受了蒙蔽，因着他们的无知和固执，与天主的生命隔绝了。

text_en: They have lost all sensitivity and have abandoned themselves to licentiousness, greedy to practice every kind of impurity.
text_cn: 这样的人既已麻木，便纵情恣欲，贪行各种不洁。

text_en: That is not the way you learned Christ!
text_cn: 但你们却不是这样学了基督。

text_en: For surely you have heard about him and were taught in him, as truth is in Jesus.
text_cn: 如果你们真听过他，按照在耶稣内的真理，在他内受过教，

text_en: You were taught to put away your former way of life, your old self, corrupt and deluded by its lusts,
text_cn: 就该脱去你们照从前生活的旧人，就是因顺从享乐的欲念而败坏的旧人，

text_en: and to be renewed in the spirit of your minds,
text_cn: 应在心思念虑上改换一新，

text_en: and to clothe yourselves with the new self, created according to the likeness of God in true righteousness and holiness.
text_cn: 穿上新人，就是按照天主的肖像所造，具有真实的正义和圣善的新人。

text_en: So then, putting away falsehood, let all of us speak the truth to our neighbors, for we are members of one another.
text_cn: 为此，你们应该戒绝谎言，彼此应该说实话，因为我们彼此都是一身的肢体。

text_en: Be angry but do not sin; do not let the sun go down on your anger,
text_cn: “你们纵然动怒，但是不可犯罪”；不可让太阳在你们含怒时西落，

text_en: and do not make room for the devil.
text_cn: 也不可给魔鬼留有余地。

text_en: Thieves must give up stealing; rather let them labor and work honestly with their own hands, so as to have something to share with the needy.
text_cn: 那以前偷窃的，不要再偷窃，却更要劳苦，亲手赚取正当的利润，好能周济贫乏的人。

text_en: Let no evil talk come out of your mouths, but only what is useful for building up, as there is need, so that your words may give grace to those who hear.
text_cn: 一切坏话都不可出于你们的口；但看事情的需要，说造就人的话，叫听众获得益处。

text_en: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, with which you were marked with a seal for the day of redemption.
text_cn: 你们不要叫天主的圣神忧郁，因为你们是在他内受了印证，以待得救的日子。

text_en: Put away from you all bitterness and wrath and anger and wrangling and slander, together with all malice,
text_cn: 一切毒辣、怨恨、忿怒、争吵、毁谤以及一切邪恶，都要从你们中除掉；

text_en: and be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, as God in Christ has forgiven you.
text_cn: 彼此相待，要良善，要仁慈，互相宽恕，如同天主在基督内宽恕了你们一样。
